{{Top|leg}}
'''Crop Blight''' was a virulent [[Disease/Legends|disease]] that affected crops. It functioned by destroying plant vascular systems and was known for spreading quickly. During the [[Dantooine Incursion]], a strain of it was quarantined by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces. However, it was found by agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and used on Dantooine crops to disrupt Republic logistics.<ref name="Starvation">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=daily|Operation Starvation}}</ref>
